- Overall performance: The company's revenue after eliminations is $16.94 billion with a gross margin of 47.1% and an EBITDA margin of 28.2%.

- Margins are at 47.1% for gross margin and 28.2% for EBITDA margin, indicating a relatively stable profitability.
- Working capital as of 2026-07-01 is influenced by days sales outstanding (DSO) of 123 days and days payables outstanding (DPO) of 300 days.
- The top 3 revenue drivers are: everything excluding business Joint Ventures with a revenue change of $0.62 billion (87.6% of total change), SAP product sales with a revenue change of $0.62 billion (88% of total change), and business Joint Ventures with a revenue change of $0.09 billion (12.4% of total change).
